Qty Add to Cart Description Mid-Fi Electronics Cocoon Pedal The Mid-Fi Electronics Cocoon pedal delivers a spongy and gritty fuzz experience with a low-to-mid gain range. Designed to emulate the feel and response of a tube amp, it offers a dynamic attack and breakup that makes it a versatile addition to any pedalboard. Mid-Fi Electronics Cocoon Pedal Review The Cocoon is a unique gain pedal with a distinct character that stands out in the crowded world of fuzz effects. Its spongy tone and gritty texture make it perfect for players seeking an organic, tube-like response. Whether used for subtle breakup or more pronounced fuzz, the Cocoons dynamic touch sensitivity ensures a responsive playing experience. Its low-to-mid gain range offers versatility, making it suitable for various styles while maintaining a signature sound.
